description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests related to git commit behavior, especially focusing on verbose and diff output handling during commit amend operations. It sets up test scenarios, creates dummy commits, and verifies the output for different configurations.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with the provided content.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets the editor used by git commands for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and command.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that the command output has the expected number of lines.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command must fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
